experiment.source: Clean three images replace Gaussian noise in both training and sampling
experiment.conditioning: Neither model receives a separate source-conditioning input
experiment.displayExamples: First six three digits from the official test split, excluded from training
experiment.scope: Generalized source denoising, not standard Gaussian diffusion; identical linear path and Euler solver, different prediction targets and induced velocity-error weighting

imageTransform: Native 32×32 state, no resizing or padding. No clipping before feature extraction.
featureTransform: Frozen continued U-Net; mid-block features averaged over all ten labels at probe timestep 500; subtract original mean and multiply by original PC1/PC2 axes.
